title: Load Balancer, Application Gateway, Front Door and Traffic Manager

videos.script: Something has to stand in front of your machines and share the traffic out. Azure has four services for it. {{four}} They are not four brands of one thing. They answer two questions. {{axes}} First, how much does it read? Layer four reads addresses and ports. Layer seven reads every web request. {{layers}} Second, where does it stand? In one region, or in front of several. {{regions}} Two questions, two answers each. That gives four boxes, and each box holds one service. {{quadrant}} You will build the first one in Bicep: a load balancer whose front end survives losing a zone. {{bicep}} Then you will ask the public DNS about two of Microsoft's own names. Traffic Manager and Front Door show up in the answers. {{dig}} Last comes the decision. Three questions, asked in order, pick the service. Often they pick more than one. {{end}}
